thread:
hana (Design): quick copy pass needed on the confirmation modal for enabling Automatic Model Fallback. Current heading is `Enable fallback?` with body text `Fallback will try cheaper models` and buttons `Cancel` / `Enable`. Feels vague about behavior and billing impact. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/fallback-modal.png :thinking:

 drew (Product): users want to know two things: 1) when fallback kicks in (latency, errors, cost), and 2) whether outputs change. also billing impact is important.

 olaf (Eng): behavior: fallback is attempted when latency > 2s or a GPU OOM/error occurs. we choose an approved compatible model; prompt/response may differ. billing: requests billed at the model variant that actually serves the request.

 hana (Design): proposed short variants (aim single sentence + clear primary CTA):
 - "Enable Automatic Model Fallback — will try compatible, lower-cost models on latency or errors. [Cancel] [Enable fallback]"
 - "Turn on fallback: automatically use cheaper models during timeouts or errors. Responses may vary. [No thanks] [Enable]"
 - "Enable fallback to reduce failures and cost. Requests use the model that serves them. [Cancel] [Turn on fallback]"
 thoughts on clarity/tone?

 sophia (QA): prefer the first option for clarity. add an inline help link to "See which models" and tests: simulate failover, ensure audit log records chosen fallback model and that the UI surfaces that choice in recent activity. Also screen-reader should read the note about output variance.

 drew (Product): small wording nit: avoid technical thresholds in modal copy. keep it high-level and link to docs for details. maybe: `Enable Automatic Model Fallback — will try compatible, lower-cost models when your primary model fails or is slow. Responses may differ.` CTA `Turn on fallback` is fine.

 olaf (Eng): agree on high-level modal. we should still include `aria-describedby` with details: "Fallback triggers on timeouts (>2s) and runtime errors. Billing uses the model that served the request." engineering can add that hidden node.

 hana (Design): updated compact copy for modal: `Enable Automatic Model Fallback — will try compatible, lower-cost models when your primary model is slow or fails. Responses may differ.` Primary CTA: `Turn on fallback` Secondary: `Cancel` Links: `See details` for docs. aria-note: add hidden description with triggers + billing note.

 sophia (QA): test checklist for PR: 1) verify audit + activity feed entry includes chosen fallback model id, 2) screen reader reads hidden description after modal opens, 3) keyboard focus lands on primary CTA by default when user invoked modal via keyboard, 4) telemetry event includes whether user saw "Responses may differ" warning.

 deploy-bot: branch "fallback-modal-copy" created -> PR #1124

 hana (Design): thanks all 44d i'll push the copy into the PR and attach the a11y checklist + microcopy screenshot.
